recipes.title: Spicy Potato Breakfast Pancakes (Indian-spiced)

items.i: red chili, seeded and finely chopped
olive oil, plus more for frying

steps: Dry-roast the cumin seeds with a pinch of salt in a non-stick pan until fragrant. Mix in a bowl with the olive oil, ginger, chili and garlic and set aside to cool.

Heat oil in a pan, add the mustard seeds until they pop, then the onion and turmeric. Add the sliced potatoes, spread them out, season and cook so they soak up the spices. Turn off the heat and let them sit.
Add the flour, salt and pepper to the cooled spice mix. Whisk in the egg, then all the milk at once, until smooth and thin; finish with 1 tsp oil for crisp edges.
Heat a large pan with a touch of oil, pour in about 1½ ladles and swirl thin. Cook until it lifts from the pan, then flip and cook until golden with crisp edges.
Lay some potato filling along one side of each pancake and roll up tightly.
Mix the coriander into the yogurt and serve on the side for dipping.
recipes.notes: Estimated amounts and macros; the video shows the method without exact quantities. A savory, Indian-inspired breakfast that's a great use for leftover potatoes.
